closest.text: Getting an education in America shouldn’t mean a lifetime of debt. About 43 million Americans now owe nearly $2 trillion in student loan debt. That’s about $43,500 per borrower, meaning people owe more for simply trying to get an education than they do on their cars or credit cards.

closest.question: immigration
closest.text: It is time we had the courage to say it plainly: mass incarceration and mass deportation are moral failures, and I will fight in the United States Senate to end them. Ending mass incarceration , including federal decriminalization of marijuana and investment in treatment over incarceration for substance use.

closest.question: healthcare
closest.text: Roughly 100 million Americans — about 4 in 10 adults — carry some form of medical debt, totaling at least $220 billion nationwide. People aren’t going into debt because they made bad choices; they’re going into debt because they got sick, had a baby or broke a bone.

closest.question: taxes
closest.text: A 5% annual wealth tax on billionaires.  I support Senator Sanders’  Make Billionaires Pay Their Fair Share Act , which would apply only to net worth above $1 billion — hitting fewer than 1,000 people in the entire country. Independent economists estimate it would raise roughly $4.4 trillion over ten years without raising taxes by a single dollar on anyone worth less than $1 billion.
